name: @apolla/desktop
description: Apolla Work 桌面客户端（Electron）——本地执行模式：内嵌 apolla server + SQLite + 本地文件存储，零部署即可运行。

scripts.start: pnpm --filter @apolla/server --filter @apolla/web --filter @apolla/runtime run build && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
